content.comment_body: Hello, I'm working on a simple control logic problem. I have three outputs that should be activated by a momentary input, while a fourth input should control all outputs based on whether any of the outputs are active. Specifically, if any of the first three outputs are on, the fourth input should turn them all off; if all outputs are off, it should turn them all on. I've attempted several solutions, but it seems that [product_name] doesn't implement the 'break before make' logic, and my circuits either function as intended or continuously cycle. Any advice would be appreciated. Thank you.
